column1: sudo mkdir -p /opt/jellyfin        # create the jellyfin directory
Verify Jellyfin Can See the Movies
You should see your movie directories/files.
docker exec jellyfin find /movies -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -20

column2: the Docker volume mapping is working.

column1: Also check the Jellyfin container's groups:
The output should include the render group.
This is important because simply seeing /dev/dri/renderD128 is not enough; Jellyfin also needs permission to use it.
